abstract: Analog front-end receivers for digital satellite reception prefer the direct conversion method which do not use SAW filters. Considerations for single carrier per channel, SCPC, reception are discussed. The author comments on the way in which base band filtering for a direct conversion receiver could be optimized.

articleTitle: A DTV reception technology using software data streaming on a personal computer
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper describes a new DTV (digital television) reception technology which relies primarily on software to receive, process and display DTV signals, which realizes an integrated DTV reception card, and real-time MPEG-2 data streaming by software on a PC (personal computer).

articleTitle: The impact of increased DTV bit rates on data broadcast receivers
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: The need for more data broadcast bandwidth challenges hardware design. Receivers for the present data services using the lines in the vertical blanking and faster partial response waveform are compared to DTV data broadcasting receivers.

articleTitle: A state scheduling technique for digitally filtering of multiple signals
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: In many applications it is desired to digitally filter more than one signal simultaneously. For video signal processing we provide a straight-forward technique for obtaining efficient VLSI implementations. By state scheduling we separate the arithmetic from the read or write operations on the states stored in the registers. The changes of the sampling rate have only an impact on the state scheduler, not the combinational logic.

articleTitle: Inter-frame vertex selection scheme for object-based image sequence coder
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper proposes a new boundary coding algorithm suitable for an object-based image sequence coding system. The boundary is approximated by a polygon which can be encoded with the smallest number of bits for maximum distortion. The temporal redundancy between two successive frames is efficiently removed with the proposed scheme, resulting in lower bit-rate than the conventional algorithms.

articleTitle: Deep UV mastering using an all-solid-state 266 nm laser for an over 14 Gb/in/sup 2/
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: The deep UV mastering process of the next generation high-density disk is demonstrated using an all-solid-state CW 266 nm laser for the first time. We achieved a density of over 14 Gbit/in/sup 2/ with acceptable jitter using both novolak type resist and chemically amplified resist.

articleTitle: New approach to develop a system solution for an integrated multi-service system
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper presents a system solution for an integrated multi-service system (IMSS) in the field of digital TV (DTV). A key element of this system is a motion picture media processor, which is based on an integrated RISC CPU, scalable DSP modules and dedicated hardware units. This concept is targeted not only for the pure reception of digital TV, but also for the interactive processing of broadcast data. The high computational performance and scalability realize the enabling functionality for new media applications.

articleTitle: DTV discretionary content: requirements for successful implementations
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: The required technologies under the evolving standards for data broadcasting and the system implications that they intimate are examined. Future-proof technologies which will allow differentiation among data services and implementation of new applications down the line are discussed.

articleTitle: Efficient shape coding algorithm for object-oriented video in MPEG-4
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: A new shape coding algorithm to improve coding efficiency is proposed. The proposed vertex selection scheme can reduce the shape points of the boundary for lossless coding and the area distortion criterion provides good rate distortion trade-off for lossy coding.

articleTitle: 4.7 Gbytes re-writable disc systems based on DVD-R systems
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: The authors have developed a 4.7 Gbyte re-writable disc system with two basic concepts: (1) they have added a re-writable feature on the DVD-R incremental write system. (2) It is physically compatible with DVD-ROM.

articleTitle: Front end processor for 48X speed CD-ROM drive
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper presents a new design methodology and experimental results of front end processor for 48X speed CD-ROM Driver. The IC consists of a main signal processing block, a track error detecting block, a focus error detecting block, an automatic laser power control block, center servo control block and other servo signal generating blocks. The front end processor for 48 X speed CD-ROM drive was designed with 0.8 /spl mu/m BiCMOS technology process and the chip size is 3750 /spl mu/m*3750 /spl mu/m. The experimental results show that its performance meets or exceeds the requirements of the 48 X speed CD-ROM drive system.

articleTitle: DTV field test measurements in the Washington, D.C. urban area
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: Summary form only given. The model HDTV Station Project has carried out a year-long extensive RF field measurement program to evaluate WHD-TV station's coverage under a number of different interference scenarios. The primary objective of the field testing program is to evaluate the performance of the ATSC system under real world conditions of variable terrain, high vegetation, and complex static and dynamic multipath generally encountered in the Washington, D.C., urban area. This paper presents information relating to the facilities employed, the test procedures used and a tabulated summary of the data collected. Indoor measurement results and comparison with other field measurement programs are also included.

articleTitle: Development of audio and video signal processing system for DV format VCR
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: We have newly developed an audio and video signal processing system for the DV format VCR. This system contains the digital partial response maximum likelihood (PRML) read channel and the circuit for analog video signal input.

articleTitle: A generic network management architecture targeted to support home automation networks and home Internet connectivity
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper proposes a generic network management architecture targeted to support home automation networks and home Internet connectivity for the purpose of control and monitoring. The core of the architecture is a new management protocol residing at the OSI application layer. The paper is structured as follows: state-of-the-art and main objective are primarily presented, and then the proposed architecture and protocol are detailed. Finally, conclusions and open issues are highlighted.

articleTitle: Decision feedback equalizer (DFE) design issues for terrestrial television receivers
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: Decision feedback equalizers (DFEs) are widely used in digital television receivers in order to combat multipath. We discuss the effect of error propagation on the performance of DFEs in digital television receivers.

articleTitle: Adaptive motion estimation technique for motion compensated interframe interpolation
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: We propose a new fast motion estimation algorithm for motion compensated interframe interpolation. We can obtain easily backward motion vectors by using a dynamic search range scheme. Also, in order to obtain the motion vectors closer to the true object motion, we utilize the local characteristics of the vector field.

articleTitle: Cablemodem standards for advanced quality of service deployments
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: The DOCSIS standard has provided a basis for the cablemodem market to take off around interoperable, multi-vendor products. The evolution of this standard to include enhanced quality of service (QoS) and enhanced physical layers affords opportunities to deploy QoS intensive applications such as voice over IP, T1 circuit replacement, interactive gaming, multimedia enhanced services and video conferencing as well as address European deployment requirements. This paper addresses the DOCSIS 1.0, 1.1 and the new 1.2 standard and its evolving features, how it compares to the DVB-RC European proposal, and what QoS services and performance levels can be obtained. Detailed analysis of mixed QoS scenarios including multi-tiered committed information rate IP service and voice over IP are presented.

articleTitle: Development of an IEEE 1394 long-haul adapter
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: We have developed a 1394 long-haul adapter that extends the distance between equipment up to 500 m while maintaining interoperability with existing 1394 devices. The adapter can be applied to the 1394-based home network and local area network.

articleTitle: Real-time event kernel architecture for home-network gateway set-top-box (HNGS)
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper presents a software architecture for home-network gateway set-top-boxes. This architecture accommodates the real-time requirements of home-network devices while also providing a practical gateway service for internetworking.

articleTitle: A new block-matching algorithm based on an adaptive search area adjustment using spatio-temporal correlation
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: A new block-matching algorithm based on an adaptive adjustment of search area using spatio-temporal correlation is presented to reduce the computational complexity of the full-search algorithm without significant degradation of video quality. It is shown that the proposed method has good video quality in terms of mean square error and has less complexity than previous works by simulation using various test video sequences.

articleTitle: Adaptive global concealment of video up-conversion artefacts
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: We present methods of concealing degradation in motion-compensated video up-conversion. Interpolated fields are shifted gradually towards the originals or one interpolation point as motion quality worsens, while they are shifted back gradually towards their correct position as motion quality improves. This algorithm has been implemented on a microprocessor's ROM which is external to an ASIC and adapts itself to global image degradation and subjective error perception.

articleTitle: An adaptive interface to accommodate Internet and data traffic for IEEE 1394
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: The Internet society has been discussing how to use IEEE Std 1394-1995 High Performance Serial Bus (1394 or bus) to transfer Internet Protocol Version 4 (Ipv4) datagrames in the last few years. The 1394 interface needs to support not only its functions but also maximize the ability of 1394 with Internet and data transfer. We propose an adaptive interface aimed at this seamless support. In this paper, we verify the necessity of the adaptive interface compared with other deterministic approaches. Finally we suggest flow classification as an adaptive policy and present several methods to identify useful flows on 1394.

articleTitle: Ultra portable LC projector with high-brightness optical system
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: In order to realize high-brightness and high quality pictures for a ultra portable liquid crystal (LC) projector, a high-collection illumination system comprising a polarization converter, multi lenses, a small-size LC panel with micro lens system and a newly color-optical system has been developed.

articleTitle: A new video interpolation technique based on motion-adaptive subsampling
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper presents a new technique to improve the performance of video interpolation by controlling the subsampling rate of a video sequence. Simulation results show that the picture quality is enhanced and the quality fluctuation is reduced.

articleTitle: Streaming of MPEG-4 speech/audio over Internet
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: Based on the client-server application model, an MPEG-4 speech/audio streaming system over the Internet is implemented and demonstrated. This system provides an architectural prototype for carriage of MPEG-4 data over the IP (Internet protocol) network via the RTSP (real time streaming protocol) and the RTP (real time protocol). MPEG-4 natural audio parametric coding functionalities are fully explored for the coding of speech signals at 2 kbps to 4 kbps and the coding of non-speech signals at bit rates of 4 kbps up to 16 kbps. A set of MPEG-4 oriented RTSP feedback controls is utilized for client-to-server interactivity.

articleTitle: A 4:2:2P@ML MPEG-2 video encoder board using an enhanced MP@ML video encoder LSI
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: We have developed a small, inexpensive 4:2:2P@ML encoder for consumer use by upgrading MP@ML video encoder LSI. The encoder is implemented on a PCI board and encodes video using both MP@ML and 4:2:2P@ML MPEG-2 standards.

articleTitle: Viterbi decoding method using channel state information in COFDM system
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: A Viterbi decoder using channel state information (CSI) is presented in a digital terrestrial television broadcasting system. The proposed Viterbi decoder uses the CSI derived from the pilots and CSI is calculated by interpolation method using the pilots in the receiver. We simulated this method in Rayleigh fading defined in ETSI standard. From the simulation, we obtained the results that this method has a better performance of about 0.15 dB to 0.7 dB and 2.2 dB to 2.9 dB in the Rayleigh channel than that of the conventional soft decision Viterbi decoding with or without bit interleaver where the constellation is QPSK, 16-QAM and 64-QAM.

articleTitle: A real-time MPEG1 Ethernet camera system
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: We have developed a real-time MPEG1 network camera system using UDP/IP on the Ethernet. Panning/tilting is available remotely through interaction between Java applets running on a WWW-browser on a PC and camera server embedded network protocols.

articleTitle: Video retrieval based on scene change detection in compressed streams
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper presents a new key frame extraction algorithm as well as a novel video-indexing scheme for fast content-based browsing and retrieval in video databases. We first extract key frames by matching the AHIM (accumulated histogram intersection measure) of the DC image sequence constructed from the MPEG video sequence. Then we use the region segmentation-based projective histogram and its moments as database indices for video retrieval.

articleTitle: Rate-distortion based optimization for zerotree entropy wavelet coding
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: We present a rate-distortion based optimization technique for a zerotree entropy wavelet coding scheme, namely the MPEG-4 visual texture coding (VTC) technique. With an accurate quadratic modeling of the rate distortion function, our algorithm precisely reaches target bit rate with better image quality using an efficient and fast iterative technique.

articleTitle: Speech synthesis method based on application-specific synthetic units and its implementation on a 32-bit microprocessor
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: A novel speech synthesis algorithm with application-specific synthesis units has been implemented in an embedded MCU. This method approximately halves the required amount of memory, making high-quality synthetic speech available in many kinds of electronic equipment.

articleTitle: A cost-efficient and fully-pipelinable architecture for DCT/IDCT
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: A novel low-cost and low-power linear array for computation of discrete cosine transform (DCT) and its inverse is derived from the heterogeneous dependence graph representing the coefficient matrix factorization. The power saving of the architecture is achieved by turning off multipliers whenever the multiplied coefficients are ones.

articleTitle: A decision-directed symbol timing recovery circuit for ATSC digital TV receivers
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: In this paper we present and analyze a full-digital decision-directed symbol timing recovery circuit based on the double-sampling maximum-likelihood estimator. Intended for the ATSC digital TV system, the proposed scheme works independently of the segment synchronization by extracting timing information from the randomized data symbols even in the extremely small roll-off case. With the proposed method we get not only quick synchronization, but also robust timing recovery with reduced timing jitter compared to the conventional correlation method. The simulation is performed using the 8-level PAM signal, and evaluated in terms of the steady-state timing jitter under AWGN and multi path ghost channels.

articleTitle: Combination of multiple turbo codes and multiple antennas for direct-sequence CDMA systems
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: A combined multiple turbo codes and multiple antenna diversity scheme for synchronous DS/CDMA systems over fading mobile radio channels is considered to improve the BER performance. In spite of the multiple structures no time delay and a lesser amount of computation can be achieved by a modified parallel mode decoding process and a reduced MAP algorithm using a code trellis structure. The performance of the proposed combining scheme is studied by means of simulation for a QPSK DS/CDMA system on a non-frequency selective Rayleigh fading channel.

articleTitle: Time-lined hypermedia for digital interactive broadcasting and its practical implementation
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper proposes a hypermedia model called time-lined hypermedia, which provides larger hypermedia navigation space in a limited broadcast bandwidth. We also describe a practical implementation of time-lined hypermedia.

articleTitle: A LOG-EXP still image compression chip design
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: In this paper, a fully pipelined single chip is proposed for LOG-EXP still image compression. The design of the LOG-EXP image compression focuses on the high compression ratio of a complex texture (e.g. benchmark image baboon) and high quality image, especially the PSNR requirement above 36. In comparison with the JPEG compression result (bpp=0.99, PSNR=26.9), this compression algorithm uses less bpp (bpp=0.87) to get a higher image quality (PSNR=36.38) for the benchmark image baboon. The entire LOG-EXP image compression system can be implemented on a single chip to yield a clock rate of 175 MHz which allow an input rate of 30 frames per second for 1024/spl times/1024 color images.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a DAB channel decoder
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper describes the design of de-interleaver and Viterbi decoder for the Eureka-147 DAB system and their corresponding VLSI implementations. We emphasize on how to efficiently handle four DAB transmission modes, time/frequency de-interleaving and path metric/survivor memory management in our development. Results show that our implementation has the potential of consuming less silicon area and power dissipation, and facilitating the extension for high transmission rate requirement.

articleTitle: A single chip RF-CMOS front end LSI for GSM handy phone
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: A 900 MHz CMOS handy phone LSI is described. Three special RF-CMOS circuit technologies, fully integrated 900 MHz VCO with spiral inductor and varicap diode, new IF local frequency circuit, and effective image rejection system, are introduced.

articleTitle: Home Network File System for home network based on IEEE-1394 technology
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: This paper proposes a network file system for home network based on IEEE-1394 technology. Home Network File System enables real-time playback, recording of audio/video file and file sharing for HAVi (home audio video interoperability) compliant consumer devices.

articleTitle: New autofocusing technique using the frequency selective weighted median filter for video cameras
publicationTitle: 1999 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (Cat. No.99CH36277)
abstract: A new autofocusing technique using the frequency selective weighted median (FSWM) filter is proposed for video cameras. The FSWM filter is resistive to impulsive noise from the CCD of the video cameras. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms existing techniques by enhancing the accuracy of the focus value of the video camera.

abstract: Presents the table of contents/splash page of the proceedings record.
